# Assigned-role routing cases

Review these synthetic cases against `skills/research-router/SKILL.md` and its
assignment/invocation references. These are instruction-review cases, not proof
certification or evidence of runtime enforcement.

| Case | Expected action | What completes the decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Primary agent with host model provenance is asked to edit ordinary prose. | Execute the content/production task directly; no consultation. | Current user assignment and host provenance; no named production preset or mathematical self-assessment required. |
| Primary agent receives an ordinary prose edit directly from the user, but the host provides no self-model metadata. | Record model/effort as unknown and execute within the assigned content/production scope. | The direct user assignment suffices unless explicit host policy restricts the agent; missing metadata alone does not trigger delegation. |
| Primary agent explains a supplied proof or offers tentative source interpretation within its content/production scope. | Continue within that scope and report uncertainty; send construction of a missing proof step to the configured proof role. | Tentative wording does not expand the primary's assignment. The decisive-result adoption check does not block ordinary explanation or certify unresolved work. |
| Proof child receives an explicit native role/model/effort assignment but has no local self-metadata. | Execute the bounded proof assignment. | Parent's native selection and assigned role suffice; no recursive qualification dispatch. |
| Summary requires a missing proof step. | Send that step to the configured proof role, carrying exact hypotheses. | Responsibility is proof construction even within an explanation. |
| A proof worker proves a decisive lemma to adopt as a research result or proof dependency. | Obtain a separate fresh verifier's check before adopting the claim. | Role assignment alone does not establish correctness; producer integration does not establish independent review. |
| A proof worker finds an unprovided compactness hypothesis. | Return the missing hypothesis and established scope, or split the bounded obligation. | Concrete unresolved proof obligation; do not silently strengthen the statement. |
| A coordinator cannot identify a configured proof role or dispatch it. | Preserve artifacts and report the missing role and unresolved work. | Do not rank unknown model families or recursively commission qualification checks. |
| Luna or Haiku is assigned a prose edit with high effort. | Hand off the entire substantive edit to a configured production worker. | The fork's evidence/coordination restriction still applies. |
| Packet model selection conflicts with host-session metadata. | Resolve the conflict with the parent before substantive work. | Role assignment does not erase conflicting invocation provenance. |
| Host exposes no effort control but supplies model provenance and a proof-role assignment. | Record effort as unsupported and execute the bounded role. | Unsupported effort is not a missing-role condition. |

## Portable availability cases retained by the fork

| Case | Expected work and boundary |
| --- | --- |
| No named host adapter exists but a general-purpose child is callable. | Assign the bounded responsibility using native defaults; no host installation is needed. |
| There is no delegation tool and a non-restricted producer must reconstruct a routine argument. | Follow the proof-worker instructions and self-check sequentially. Keep independently required decisive-result adoption pending until fresh review exists. |
| A host explicitly assigns evidence-only permissions. | Do not make substantive edits; return the concrete assignment limit. |
| Only adapters for another host are installed. | Use the actual callable interface or the authorized sequential fallback. |
| The assigned non-restricted producer has no exposed runtime metadata. | Execute the directly authorized task and record metadata as unknown. |
| A native child invocation fails due to capacity or access. | Use a genuinely callable route or authorized sequential fallback, without looping or changing configuration. |
